hours_rule: Earliest published opening and latest published closing across saved weekday, holiday and term/vacation schedules. Ignore closed days and gaps. Treat midnight/02:00 closings as next-day times. A published 24-hour schedule makes the bound 24 hours. This is an approximation, not a claim of daily availability.
hours_source: Saved NUS directory snapshots recorded in collection.json; new floor sources do not silently replace the saved schedules.

source_anomalies.message: Arise and Shine vacation weekday source says 8.00pm–6.00pm, inconsistent with the other daytime schedules. Kept the defensible 0800–1800 bound from term/weekend hours; did not infer a 22-hour overnight session or silently correct pm to am.
